scope: Each fresh SDK session receives one continuous clip with 2-4 GT speakers; source whole meetings have 5-6 speakers and are not fed in full.
selectionRule: One previously unused recording from each small/medium/large room: target 2/3/4 speakers respectively; lexicographically first meeting and earliest 30-second-grid start >=180 seconds; clip 180 seconds; every speaker >=10 annotated seconds and >=2 reference segments. No reference segments, including brief speech or overlaps, are discarded when counting speakers.
acceptance: Report DER (250ms collar, no overlap), speaker confusion, unknown/miss, per-reference named speaker switches and cross-person ID sharing; preserve absolute identity failures separately from improvement vs baseline. Compare current output to pre-gap sampling and original 2.5s/no-query state on same PCM and public boundaries. Do not tune or replace selected inputs after seeing results.
deviceRisk: Validate independent 2/3/4-speaker meetings through public SDK with unique last then complete, no early last/error, stream cleanup and intermediate window freezing.
stop: One run per selected clip. Preserve every failed case and stop extra reruns; no threshold or sample substitutions.
evidence: Raw report, per-session callbacks, hilog, memory samples, input-to-source map and immutable hashes.
invalidation: Runtime, model, parameters, selected PCM or HAP/HAR contents change.
